name: Write File
description: Write a text file in the sandbox, or delete a file or folder. Paths: /work (this chat's scratch; relative paths go here), /project (kept), /shared/<this workspace> (kept; other workspaces can read it), /public (live web pages). Other workspaces' /shared folders are read-only. Deleting /work, /project or /shared/<this workspace> itself empties it; deleting works even over the size limit.
author: anything

examples.prompt: Save these figures as a CSV we can use later

content.description: The whole file, at most 1 MB. Leave out when deleting.

delete.description: true to delete the file or folder at path.
